name: Billionaire | 2pck Hemp Wrap | Pink Lemonade
description: A hemp wrap is a tobacco-free and nicotine-free rolling sheet made from industrial hemp fiber. Designed as an alternative to traditional blunt wraps, it is thicker than standard rolling paper, burns slowly, and provides an earthy, neutral taste that complements legal smoking blends.
